name: Open Dental
description: Open Dental is dental-practice management software for appointments, patients, clinical records, treatment plans, insurance, billing, payments, communications, reporting, and office administration. Its remote REST API routes approved requests to an authorized practice through the Open Dental eConnector.
agentUseSummary: Open Dental is visible as a developer-review preview only. Relay will not collect an Open Dental login, developer key, customer key, patient identifier, chart, treatment plan, insurance detail, payment detail, or other credential, and no agent action is callable until Open Dental and Relay's healthcare owners approve the exact bounded read-only contract.

capabilities.label: Read approved Open Dental practice summaries
capabilities.description: After Open Dental and Relay's healthcare owners approve the integration, read only bounded appointment, provider, clinic, and minimized patient-summary data for one exact practice and explicitly approved fields.

blocked.label: Connect before developer approval
blocked.description: Open Dental requires vendor-relations approval, a Developer Portal account and developer key, a customer-specific key enabled by the dental office, exact API permissions, and a BAA. Relay has none of those approvals or production credentials.

blocked.label: Collect clinical or application credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask for an Open Dental login, developer key, customer key, patient identifier, chart, treatment plan, insurance detail, payment detail, or other secret as a substitute for approved practice authorization.

blocked.label: Run Open Dental API actions
blocked.description: No patient, appointment, chart, treatment, prescription, insurance, billing, claim, payment, communication, report, query, subscription, or other Open Dental API action can run while developer and healthcare review is pending.

blocked.label: Clinical, operational, and financial mutations unavailable
blocked.description: Patient or chart changes, appointment creation or updates, prescriptions, treatment plans, insurance, billing, claims, payments, communications, arbitrary queries, subscriptions, bulk exports, raw PHI, and every mutation remain outside Relay's planned read-only V1 even after approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Open Dental developer review pending
approvalProfiles.description: Practice reads remain unavailable until Developer Portal approval, customer enablement, exact permissions, BAA, privacy, security, and healthcare compliance are accepted.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable until Open Dental approves Relay and Relay implements the approved read-only Railway broker.
No Hermes tools are callable until Open Dental approves Relay and Relay implements the approved read-only Railway broker.

providerSetup.blocker: Open Dental documents a broad REST API with read and mutation permissions, but production use requires vendor-relations approval, a Developer Portal account and developer key, a customer-specific key enabled by the exact dental office, permission selection, eConnector availability, and a BAA. Relay has no approved developer account, production keys, office authorization, BAA and HIPAA allocation, minimum-necessary field map, security acceptance, or production authority.
providerSetup.nextAction: Authorized Relay business, legal, privacy, security, healthcare compliance, and product owners must apply for Open Dental Developer Portal access, execute the required BAA and commercial terms, obtain one exact practice's sponsorship and customer-key enablement, and secure written approval for only the bounded read-only use case. They must document exact resources and minimized fields, authorized users and practices, patient consent and purpose limitation, tenancy, audit, retention, deletion, breach duties, throttling, disconnect, and production acceptance. Engineering can then implement a fixed-origin Railway broker for only approved bounded practice-summary reads. Clinical, scheduling, prescription, treatment, insurance, billing, claims, payment, communication, arbitrary-query, subscription, bulk-export, raw-PHI, and every mutation surface remain excluded.

evidence.supports: Open Dental documents its REST API, recommends it for most integrations, describes GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE semantics, and says API developers should have a BAA with clients.
Open Dental requires vendor-relations approval for Developer Portal access, a developer key and customer-specific key, customer enablement inside Open Dental, and an eConnector for the remote API.
Open Dental publishes granular permissions and per-location pricing, including a free read-all tier and paid permission tiers, with billing beginning only after a key is assigned and enabled.
Open Dental documents fixed remote routing through api.opendental.com and the customer eConnector, credential and permission errors, per-customer throttling, queueing, and Retry-After behavior.
